title: PyRITE: Python-based Radiative Interaction and Transport Engine
description: PyRITE (Python-based Radiative Interaction and Transport Engine) is a Python-native Monte Carlo toolkit for simulating electron transport and X-ray emission in crystalline and amorphous solids. It combines electron scattering and energy-loss modelling with calculations of parametric X-ray radiation, coherent bremsstrahlung, bremsstrahlung, and characteristic X-ray emission. Researchers can investigate how beam properties, material composition, crystal orientation, target geometry, and detector configuration affect predicted radiation spectra. PyRITE provides a Python API, command-line workflows, interactive analysis applications, and optional GPU acceleration for studies of electron–matter interactions and crystal-based X-ray sources.
